summary: Learn climate budget tagging, execution review, and performance reporting through practical public-finance exercises. Explore the course outline.
lede: Climate-responsive budgeting training helps public finance teams link climate priorities to budgets and track allocations through spending and reporting. It is for treasury and ministry budget officers, climate-finance teams, local-government planners and donor programme finance staff, and builds practical skills in setting tagging criteria, comparing planned allocations with actual expenditure, and designing indicators and reporting plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public and donor-funded professionals who connect climate priorities to budget preparation, expenditure tracking, execution, or results reporting.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public budgeting, programme finance, or climate-related planning is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop and, where available, a non-sensitive budget or programme example for adaptation exercises; the course activities can also use sample information.
